reviewer: Astra parent; did not author the two Android production fixes
scope: Resolve original01 and03 residuals from independent Android source rereview; no acceptance or hardware credits

findings.status: resolved in inspected source and focused production-helper tests
findings.evidence: Outbox construction/sanitization and inactive queue preparation happen before lifecycle commit. Prepared.publish rechecks exact token/pair/deadline after acquiring admission lock. Install only publishes prepared state; collector registration and persisted retries run afterward as generation-owned work. Failed preparation stops and joins inactive resources.

findings.status: resolved in inspected source and real socket tests
findings.evidence: SocketPlinkServer.acceptExchange(admissionLock,captureAdmission) executes nonblocking channel.accept and captures/tracks immutable admission in one generation lock. Delay/poll/read happen outside it. Controller uses captured lease through dispatch; control hello explicitly releases ordinary socket ownership before handing to reconnect.

limitations: Whole Android application lifecycle still needs frozen build and emulator/live-device verification.
The original six resolved source findings remain attributed to the independent rereview; this is a bounded follow-up for the two residuals.
